notes.title: Memori Update 0.9.3: Introducing Advanced Physics and Sound Design
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, Memori enthusiasts and backers! We're excited to bring you a whirlwind of updates for Chapter 2![/h2]

Brace yourselves, because version 0.9.3 introduces the fan mechanic. This exciting environmental feature throws a whole new element into the mix – the wind! You'll need to master the art of adapting your movements as the wind pushes you around the map. This adds a delightful layer of challenge and strategic platforming to Chapter 2.

[h2]Enhanced Soundscapes and More Immersive World
[/h2]
We've completely revamped our enemy and sound managers. This not only creates a more immersive experience while exploring Memori's captivating world, but also allows us to design intricate enemy encounters and soundscapes in future rooms.

[h2]Expanding the World of Memori
[/h2]
Speaking of rooms, buckle up! We've added a whopping 30 new rooms to Chapter 2, giving you even more stunning environments to explore in your search for your feline friend.
A Feast for the Senses

Immerse yourself further with our addition of high-quality sounds that bring Memori's world to life in all its auditory glory. Plus, a dynamic camera system adds another layer of visual polish to your adventure.

[h2]Secrets Unveiled!
[/h2]
Hold onto your hats, explorers! We've implemented an exciting new progression manager. Keep your eyes peeled for secret walls and gates that respond to collectible pickups. These hidden passages will unlock tantalizing secrets within the game, rewarding your keen sense of exploration.

[h2]Smoother Sailing
[/h2]
And to top it all off, we've improved our room transitions for a seamless and enjoyable gameplay experience.

Get ready to experience a whole new level of challenge and wonder in Memori! We can't wait for you to dive into Chapter 2 and discover all the exciting secrets it holds.

notes.title: Biggest update yet! (Version 0.9)
notes.content:
[h1] 📢New Features in 0.9 [/h1]

[h2] All updates made in version [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42243550/a4b7a9b79173db51f4d0cb59ce755df20befbf2f.png[/img]

[list]
[*] [b]New Chapter with Twilight Mechanic:[/b] Experience a complete chapter introducing the Twilight Mechanic, where you traverse the world as an unstoppable ball. This mechanic requires maintaining momentum to move effectively while navigating between the physical and twilight realms.
[*] [b]Enhanced High-Resolution UI:[/b] The user interface has been upgraded to higher resolution, incorporating numerous quality of life (QoL) features. This includes the implementation of an assist mode for accessibility and a debug mode for those interested in exploring the game mechanics more deeply.
[*] [b]Leaderboards:[/b] A new leaderboard system has been introduced, allowing players to compare their speedrunning times against others. This competitive feature adds an extra layer of challenge and community engagement to the game.
[*] [b]Sound Update:[/b] The game now features updated sound effects, ensuring each action and environment feels more satisfying and impactful. These enhancements aim to deepen immersion and enhance the overall gameplay experience.
[*] [b]First Ever Cinematic:[/b] For the first time in the game's history, players will be treated to a cinematic. This addition aims to enrich the storytelling aspect of the game, providing deeper context and emotional engagement with the game's narrative and characters.
[/list]

[h2] Art updates! [/h2]

[list]
[*] Improved art sprites for more detailed and expressive characters and elements.
[*] Enhanced backgrounds, foregrounds, and environmental designs for a more immersive experience.
[*] Advanced parallax effects, adding depth and dynamism to the game's world.
[*] Updated animations and special effects (FX) for smoother and more visually appealing movement and interactions.
[/list]

notes.title: The Boss Fight Update (Version 0.6)
notes.content:

[*] Developed the inaugural boss encounter for the game

[*] Orchestrated a heart-pounding escape sequence

notes.title: One of the Largest Updates yet! (😽The Purrfect Companion, 0.5.3.1 😺)
notes.content:
[h1] 📢New Features in 0.5.3.1 [/h1]

[list]
[*] Smoother movement dashes
[*] Enhanced responsiveness during transitions between player states
[*] Introduction of new Chapter 3 enemies and mechanics
[*] Welcome a new cat companion that follows your every move! 😽
[*] Added a debug mode for detailed movement analysis
[*] Chapter 1 art receives an exciting art and level design update
[*] Enriched experience with new parallax elements for each chapter
[/list]

Would you like to be updated more on the game or get access to our private demo? you can find out more here: [url=https://discord.com/invite/waTsVm9FsP]discord[/url]:

[url=https://discord.com/invite/waTsVm9FsP][img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1712700/extras/Discord_Social_Banner.png?t=1687379115[/img][/url]

Get ready for a smoother, more dynamic gameplay experience with improved movement dashes and highly responsive controls for seamless state transitions. Chapter 3 introduces fresh challenges with new enemies and mechanics. Plus, meet your new companion - a lovable cat that follows your every move! For the detail-oriented players, enjoy the new debug mode to analyze movement paths and states. Chapter 1 also receives a visual upgrade, along with the addition of captivating new parallax elements. Elevate your precision platforming adventure!

[h1] Meet Jasper the Cat [/h1]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1712700/ss_0703f4dd148c4402281fa4a7f11d480fb300dbe2.1920x1080.jpg?t=1694423991[/img]

Introducing our biggest update yet for the precision platformer! Alongside extensive movement and control enhancements, say hello to Jasper the cat, your new loyal companion on this adventure. Beyond her adorable exterior, Jasper will play a vital role in both gameplay mechanics and the game's lore.

[h1]movement updates [/h1]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1712700/ss_0a94f41f10a6fbec0abda3b4f8622a1b61cf6111.600x338.jpg?t=1694423991[/img]

In this latest game update, you'll notice a significant improvement in gameplay mechanics. Movement dashes have been fine-tuned for a smoother experience, ensuring seamless transitions between player states with highly responsive controls. Chapter 3 introduces a fresh array of enemies and mechanics, adding an exciting layer of challenge. Notably, dash distances now dynamically adapt based on previous object interactions and states, enhancing the precision and strategic elements of your gameplay. Get ready for a more immersive and engaging gaming experience!

notes.title: Version 0.4.0 coming by the end of July for closed playtesting!
notes.content:
[h1]📢 Exciting Announcement: Join Closed Playtesting for Memori Version 0.4.0![/h1]


To join the closed playtest, please join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/waTsVm9FsP]discord[/url]:

[url=https://discord.com/invite/waTsVm9FsP][img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1712700/extras/Discord_Social_Banner.png?t=1687379115[/img][/url]



We are thrilled to announce the imminent arrival of Memori Version 0.4.0! As the month draws to a close, we cordially invite you to take part in our exclusive closed playtesting phase, where you'll get an early taste of the thrilling new features and enhancements we have in store.

[h2]What to look forward to in this next update:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Unleash the Power of this new chapter: Brace yourself for the heart-pounding forced dash mechanic, injecting a surge of adrenaline and speed into every level. With this fast-paced addition, you'll need lightning reflexes to overcome the challenges that lie ahead.

[*] Explore the Enchanting Ice Biome: Embark on a captivating journey through an enchanting ice biome, where a frozen wonderland awaits. Immerse yourself in the eerie visuals and conquer unique obstacles that will put your skills to the test.

[*] Conquer the Thrilling Falling Spikes Escape Sequence: Get ready for a white-knuckle escape sequence filled with falling spikes. Your agility and quick thinking will be pushed to their limits as you navigate this adrenaline-fueled obstacle course to safety.

[*] But wait, there's more! Memori Version 0.4.0 is packed with additional enhancements, surprises, and fine-tuned elements to ensure an unforgettable gaming experience.

[/list]
We eagerly invite you to participate in our closed playtesting phase, where your valuable feedback will help us shape Memori into a masterpiece. Stay tuned for further details on how you can join this exclusive opportunity and be among the first to witness the evolution of this extraordinary game.

Thank you for your unwavering support, and we can't wait to embark on this thrilling new adventure with you!

The Memori Development Team

notes.title: Huge Quality of Life updates for speedrunning - Demo update 0.3.0.1
notes.content:
Introducing the Speedrunning Update!

Memori is thrilled to unveil the highly anticipated 0.3.0.1 update, packed with an array of exciting improvements tailored specifically for our vibrant speedrunning community. Brace yourself for a slew of quality of life enhancements that will elevate your gameplay experience to new heights.

Not only that, but we've also injected a breath of fresh air into our game by introducing a set of meticulously crafted, cleaner levels. Prepare to be captivated by their sleek design and seamless navigation.

Get ready to race against the clock and conquer the challenges that await you in Memori's latest update!

Key features of this update include:
[list]
[*] Speedrunning mode
[*] quickly restarting your runs without any delay
[*] cleaner rooms, better design, improved colors
[/list]

For those of you who are interested, we are also hosting the speedrunning completion during the steam next fest week!

you can find all of the information on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/kYn55n8u3P]discord[/url]
